d:
A heavy, flightless avian species with a stout build, featuring deep navy plumage and a thick, rounded beak. The head is adorned with a crown of short, deep navy feathers and stern, narrow golden eyes. The wings are stunted with deep navy feathers and the tail is a short, thick deep navy plume. Three thick claws per foot and three sharp talons per wing-hand.
BODY COLOR: deep navy
